verdict.rationale: GoDaddy exposes a full REST API (Domains v3, Commerce, DNS, etc.) with Bearer/PAT auth, rate-limit headers, stable error codes, and OpenAPI specs, plus a CLI (gddy) that can be scripted/piped and used non-interactively, all of which support headless/CI automation. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions), no independent/hands-on confirmation of CI usage, and no dedicated non-interactive/service-account auth flow described beyond PATs.
